references.text: Aaron stood between the dead and the living and stopped the plague, which is the immediate context for this verse.
Phinehas also stopped a plague among the people of Israel through his action, paralleling how Aaron stopped the plague.
Moses commanded Aaron to take the fire pan and make atonement for the people to stop the plague.
Incense used in worship and atonement, as Aaron used incense to stop the plague.
Phinehas stepped forward and executed judgment, and the plague was stopped - using the same language about stopping a plague.
David built an altar and the plague over Israel was stopped, following a similar pattern of atonement that stops God's judgment.
Jesus as high priest intercedes for his people, just as Aaron interceded and stopped the plague.
